create_random_erasing_augmentation: create a RandomErasing transform to randomly erase rectangular regions in image tensors
apply_random_erasing_to_batch: apply RandomErasing to a batch of normalized image tensors with configurable probability
configure_erasing_pixel_mode: configure RandomErasing with pixel mode for per-pixel random normal color erasing
use_erasing_cube_mode: use RandomErasing cube mode to apply the same erase region across a batch
get_random_pixels_for_patch: generate random pixel values for a patch using normal distribution or zeros
